name: Generic SMS Gateway
description: Connect to any SMS API provider with configurable HTTP endpoints, authentication, and message formatting. Supports Twilio, Nexmo, Africa's Talking, and custom SMS gateways.
author: SchoolPilot3 Team

settings.label: SMS Provider
settings.description: Select your SMS provider or choose Custom for any other API

settings.label: API URL
settings.description: Base URL of the SMS API (e.g., https://api.sms-provider.com)

settings.label: Authentication Type
settings.description: How to authenticate with the API

settings.label: API Key
settings.description: API Key (for API Key or Bearer auth)

settings.label: API Secret
settings.description: API Secret (for some providers)

settings.label: API Key Header Name
settings.description: Header name for API key (default: X-API-Key)

settings.label: Username
settings.description: Username (for Basic auth)

settings.label: Password
settings.description: Password (for Basic auth)

settings.label: Custom Headers (JSON)
settings.description: Custom headers as JSON object

settings.label: Send SMS Endpoint
settings.description: Endpoint path for sending SMS (e.g., /sms/send, /messages)

settings.label: HTTP Method
settings.description: HTTP method for sending SMS

settings.label: Request Format
settings.description: How to format the request body

settings.label: Phone Number Field Name
settings.description: Field name for recipient phone number (e.g., 'to', 'phone', 'recipient')

settings.label: Message Field Name
settings.description: Field name for message text (e.g., 'message', 'text', 'body')

settings.label: Sender ID Field Name
settings.description: Field name for sender ID (optional, e.g., 'from', 'sender')

settings.label: Sender ID
settings.description: Your sender ID or phone number

settings.label: Additional Fields (JSON)
settings.description: Additional fields to include in every request

settings.label: Response Format
settings.description: Expected response format from API

settings.label: Success Field Path
settings.description: Path to success indicator in response (e.g., 'success', 'status', 'data.success')

settings.label: Success Value
settings.description: Value that indicates success (e.g., 'true', 'sent', '200', 'ok')

settings.label: Message ID Field Path
settings.description: Path to message ID in response (e.g., 'messageId', 'id', 'data.message_id')

settings.label: Status Check Endpoint
settings.description: Endpoint for checking message status (optional, e.g., /sms/status/{messageId})

settings.label: Enable Request Logging
settings.description: Log all SMS requests for debugging
